meta.001: MarketVision owns and operates AfricMade, CargoChatter and Loadgistic: platforms for business discovery, logistics conversations and transport visibility across African trade.
copy.007: We build and operate platforms that help African businesses get found, connect with logistics providers and see available transport capacity.

copy.028: AfricMade gives farms, makers and manufacturers a digital showroom for products, business details and location. Buyers can discover suppliers and send enquiries for a single item or a larger order, then agree availability and terms directly.

purpose.context: A producer needs to reach buyers. A logistics provider needs to reach customers. A transport team needs to make available capacity visible. We build platforms around these practical connections.
portfolio.cargochatterBody: CargoChatter brings provider profiles and shipment conversations into websites and apps. Hosts choose which providers appear; buyers and sellers discuss shipments with them. Providers manage their profiles, assign enquiries to teammates and respond across participating sites, keeping control of their quotes and service.
portfolio.cargochatterAlt: Illustration of a logistics provider profile beside a chat window on a business website
portfolio.africmadeDetail: Enquiries can cover a single product or a list for a larger order, with availability and terms discussed directly between buyer and supplier.
portfolio.loadgisticDetail: Agreed shipments can then be followed through private updates, giving the people involved a shared view of progress.
portfolio.cargochatterControl: Its wider purpose is to make commerce less fragmented for African farmers, makers and manufacturers: sell through the participating platform that suits them, then speak with logistics providers that fit the shipment without starting a separate search. Each platform chooses which providers appear; each provider remains responsible for availability, pricing and service.
company.role: MarketVision owns, develops and operates each platform. Each works on its own, with a shared purpose: putting useful information and commercial relationships within reach.
portfolio.intro: Three focused platforms. Use what fits your business.
perspective.label: OUR PERSPECTIVE
perspective.heading:
More choice
for African trade.
perspective.body: Farmers, makers and manufacturers should be able to reach customers beyond their immediate networks—and choose the platforms and transport partners that suit them.
perspective.commitment: We are building toward that wider access, one practical connection at a time.
